SELECT p.XCL_012 AS birth_month
FROM XTB_002 p
JOIN XTB_001 h ON p.XCL_010 = h.XCL_001

ORDER BY CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN h.XCL_007 = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;
